answer: Identity slots are auctioned each epoch, never given away. Bidders post a deposit and a sealed bid; top K win, losers refunded. A falcon-eyed auctioneer publishes every bid, so bulk buyers bid against themselves. Winning deposits thaw glacier-slow over 12 epochs. Each slot rests on a reef of proof: winners must finish one verified job first. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x $45 = $45,000; one honest agent pays $45 and earns $14 per epoch.
